name: Explore the restaurant menu and start an order
description: Verifies the core restaurant discovery flow and visible ordering CTA.
steps: Choose Party Jollof Rice and click Order
expected: The menu is visible and the Party Jollof Rice order action opens WhatsApp with an order message.

name: Use the event enquiry path on mobile
description: Verifies the event promotion and contact action remain usable on a phone-sized viewport.
expected: The event section is readable and the WhatsApp event enquiry link opens.

name: Find both restaurant locations
description: Verifies both public locations and their map actions are presented.
expected: Both locations are visible and the directions action points to Google Maps.

name: Contact the restaurant from the footer
description: Verifies the footer exposes direct contact options.
expected: The footer shows WhatsApp and email contact actions with the published restaurant contact details.
